newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon four-month BoP surplus $500 mln - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon four-month BoP surplus $500 mln - c.bank.

text.p: Lebanon had a balance of payments surplus of $500 million in the first four months of the year, Bank of Lebanon Governor Riad Salameh said on Wednesday.
"Lebanon's balance of payments registered at the end of April a surplus of $500 million," Salameh told Arab bankers and financiers at a conference in Beirut.
This compared with a surplus of $564 million in the first quarter, according to Bank of Lebanon statistics issued in April.
In 1996 Lebanon had a first quarter balance of payments surplus of $30 million. It had a $291 million deficit in the first quarter of 1995.
